_comment: What the ingester produced on the REAL tornadohvacca.com export. The export is client
data and is not committed (it lives at ~/Desktop/tornadohvacca_com_all_exports.zip), so
CI cannot reproduce these numbers. They are written down anyway because urls/zeroH1Pages/
untaggedPages were documented in AUTOMATION-CONTEXT.md §9 BEFORE any pipeline code
existed, which makes reproducing them the one non-circular validation this ingester has.
TWO CONSUMERS, and they are the reason this is a data file rather than a literal inside a
test. tests/unit/recorded-export.test.ts asserts that this record still describes LIVE
code — every checkId is registered, every unmeasured key is a signal the ingester can
actually emit, and the arithmetic between the figures holds. scripts/audit-dry-run.ts
--compare diffs a real run against the same file and exits 2 on any mismatch, so Matt's
run against the real export is machine-checked instead of eyeballed.
These figures deliberately DIFFER from fixtures/eval/tornado/manifest.json (191/92/187/
7/8/148). That manifest transcribes §9's documented magnitudes against the HAND-BUILT
eval fixture; this file records what the real export actually contains. Nothing is ever
gated against the manifest, and the eval fixtures are never converted to record-and-
replay — the manifest's figures were written before the pipeline existed, and a replay

ONPAGE-003.why: 191 pages with no H1 plus 3 with several
